facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹3,899 cr, +35% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹345 cr, +9% on the prior twelve months.
Jun 2026 quarter: revenue ₹946 cr (+41% YoY), PAT ₹56.0 cr (−25% YoY), operating margin 15.6%.
Revenue has compounded at 54% over 5 and 48% over 3; the last twelve months (+35%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (51% vs 48%).
Operating margin is steady at 15.6% (16.8% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹913 cr against equity of ₹4,748 cr: debt/equity 0.19× (was 0.16× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 6.0× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹511 cr, 32% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 193 days from 162 in Mar 2023 (debtor days 74 → 154, payable days 103 → 131): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 53.3%, −0.1 pp over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 6.1%, −4.6 pp over a year.
Over 5 years the business reported ₹1,516 cr of operating profit but operating cash flow was −₹615 cr: profits have not turned into cash.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years; cumulative −₹3,288 cr, latest year −₹1,841 cr.
Capex ran at 34% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,241 cr (averaged 20% over the three years before).

business.what: Kaynes Technology is an electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) company. It provides integrated services including R&D, product design, manufacturing, testing, and full lifecycle management for sectors like automotive, industrial, medical, telecom, and consumer electronics.

claims.claim: Profitability will take a couple of quarters to normalize.
claims.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize and return to the levels as we had earlier committed to.

claims.claim: Kaynes is the number one in meter installation.
claims.quote: I want to reiterate amongst all the metering companies which are doing assembling, we continue to be the number one installation done across the country than any other competition.

claims.claim: Receivables from the leading EV customer have dropped below INR100 crores.
claims.quote: the receivable from our leading electric vehicle two-wheeler customer, where on most of your right the concern, has come down significantly to below the INR100 crores

claims.claim: OSAT and PCB commercial production starts next quarter.
claims.quote: our commercial production is set to start from the next quarter, and our team is doing the last-minute finishing of the capital, and we are on track as per our commitment.

claims.claim: The company has not seen a structural deterioration in demand, order book quality or customer relevance.
claims.quote: The company has not seen a structural deterioration in demand, order book quality or customer relevance.

claims.claim: Rail business margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.
claims.quote: the margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.

claims.claim: The metering business working capital issue will be reversed within 3 quarters.
claims.quote: we have a very clear strategy on how we are going to come out of this cash flow issue in the metering business.

claims.claim: The order book is growing at about 50% per annum.
claims.quote: order book health has been good. We are growing at about 50% per annum basis, and that's the monthly order inflow.

claims.claim: We are almost cash positive in the holding company level.
claims.quote: We are almost cash positive in the holding company level, which has never happened in the past.

claims.claim: The OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational and steadily ramping up.
claims.quote: The OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational and steadily ramping up.

claims.claim: Operating EBITDA margin expanded by 190 basis points year-on-year to 16.3%.
claims.quote: This translates into an EBITDA margin of 16.3%, an -- expansion of 190 basis points year-on-year.

claims.claim: The company is successfully transforming from an EMS player to a fully integrated ESDM company.
claims.quote: As we are successfully transforming from being an electronic manufacturing service, EMS player to a fully integrated electronic system design and manufacturing, ESDM company

claims.claim: The company has received government approval for advanced PCB manufacturing projects.
claims.quote: The recent government of India approval for our advanced PCB manufacturing projects, including Kaynes marks a watershed moment for nation's industrial and technological ambitions.

claims.claim: The company expects to achieve significant positive operating cash flow by the year-end.
claims.quote: we think that we'll be able to give you a -- significant positive OCF by the year-end.

claims.claim: Margin expansion is driven by gross margin improvements across all six verticals and operating leverage.
claims.quote: In addition to that, we have seen increase in gross margins across the board. That means all the 6 verticals, the orders have anywhere between 50 basis point to 200 basis point increase.

claims.claim: The company is aiming for 15% of the total smart meter market.
claims.quote: So smart meter, like we said, we are aiming at about 15% of the total market.

claims.claim: OSAT facility is on track for commercial production by December 2025.
claims.quote: OSAT facility in Sanand is almost there with proto products for AOS and is on track to be fully operational for commercial production by December '25.

claims.claim: The order book surged from INR41,152 million at the end of Q4 of FY ’24 to INR65,969 million at the end of Q4 FY ’25.
claims.quote: Our order book surged from INR41,152 million at the end of Q4 of FY ’24 to INR65,969 million at the end of Q4 FY ’25.

claims.claim: The order book today contains orders which are higher margin than what we are delivering right now.
claims.quote: suffice it to say that the order book today contains orders which are higher margin than what we are delivering right now.

synthesis.one_liner: Rapid revenue expansion and stable margins are undermined by severe cash drain, widening working capital cycles, and missed topline guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management repeatedly guided for ₹4,500 cr FY26 revenue with 60% growth and targets $1 billion by FY28.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FY26 revenue missed guidance at ₹3,626 cr, while LTM revenue growth slowed to 35% from a 48% 3-year pace.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims the company is almost cash positive and will turn cash positive by the end of FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 5-year cumulative operating cash flow was −₹615 cr against ₹1,516 cr operating profit, with latest FCF at −₹1,841 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management expected FY26 EBITDA margin expansion of 50 bps and operating profitability above 15.6%.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Operating margin met targets reaching 15.9% in FY26 and remaining steady at 15.6% in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management targets net working capital of 70 to 85 days and expects working capital issues to reverse.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Cash conversion cycle lengthened to 193 days from 162 days, driven by debtor days rising to 154.

synthesis.credibility: Management has 2 delivered, 2 missed, and 13 unmeasured items out of 18. It met margin expansion goals but significantly missed its FY26 revenue guidance of ₹4,500 cr by reporting ₹3,626 cr.

bull.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month revenue reached ₹3,899 cr, representing a 35% year-on-year increase.

Jun 2026 quarter PAT fell 25% year-on-year to ₹56.0 cr.
Debtor days surged from 74 to 154, expanding cash conversion cycle to 193 days.
